properties.name: cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Browser origins allowed to call this service, comma separated, for the test console (console/console.html). Empty means CORS is off. Never set this in production. Set with CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

properties.name: internal.key
properties.description: Shared secret between our own services, sent in the X-Internal-Key header. Required. Set with INTERNAL_KEY.

properties.name: payment.base-url
properties.description: Address of payment-service. Only used when agent.business-payments is on. Set with PAYMENT_BASE_URL.

properties.name: ganji.base-url
properties.description: Private address of ganji-api. Set with GANJI_BASE_URL.

properties.name: ganji.public-url
properties.description: Public address of ganji-api, which customers' phones open from links in chat. Set with GANJI_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.

properties.name: anthropic.api-key
properties.description: Anthropic API key used for the agent's Claude calls. Required. Set with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

properties.name: anthropic.base-url
properties.description: Anthropic API address. Set with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL.

properties.name: anthropic.model
properties.description: Claude model the agent uses. Set with ANTHROPIC_MODEL.

properties.name: anthropic.max-tokens
properties.description: Largest reply, in tokens, requested from Claude in one call. Set with ANTHROPIC_MAX_TOKENS.

properties.name: anthropic.version
properties.description: Value sent in the anthropic-version header.

properties.name: stt.enabled
properties.description: Turn voice note transcription on. Audio leaves your servers when this is on. Set with STT_ENABLED.

properties.name: stt.base-url
properties.description: Speech to text provider address. Any provider with an OpenAI compatible POST {base-url}/audio/transcriptions works. Set with STT_BASE_URL.

properties.name: stt.api-key
properties.description: Speech to text provider key. Set with STT_API_KEY.

properties.name: stt.model
properties.description: Speech to text model. Set with STT_MODEL.

properties.name: stt.language
properties.description: Language of voice notes. Leave blank to detect it, since customers mix English and Swahili. Set with STT_LANGUAGE.

properties.name: tts.enabled
properties.description: Turn spoken replies to voice notes on (POST {base-url}/audio/speech). Set with TTS_ENABLED.

properties.name: tts.base-url
properties.description: Text to speech provider address. Set with TTS_BASE_URL.

properties.name: tts.api-key
properties.description: Text to speech provider key. Set with TTS_API_KEY.

properties.name: tts.model
properties.description: Text to speech model. Set with TTS_MODEL.

properties.name: tts.voice
properties.description: Voice used for spoken replies. Set with TTS_VOICE.

properties.name: business.name
properties.description: Business name the agent uses when talking to customers. Set with BUSINESS_NAME.

properties.name: business.support-phone
properties.description: Support number the agent gives customers. Set with BUSINESS_SUPPORT_PHONE.

properties.name: agent.store
properties.description: Where chat state is kept: redis in production, or memory (this process only) for local development. Set with AGENT_STORE.

properties.name: agent.history-size
properties.description: How many recent messages are kept for each customer's conversation.

properties.name: agent.history-ttl
properties.description: How long an idle conversation is kept.

properties.name: agent.rate-limit-per-minute
properties.description: Most messages one customer can send in a minute. Set with AGENT_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.

properties.name: agent.max-tool-rounds
properties.description: Most tool-calling rounds the agent runs for one customer message.

properties.name: agent.intent-ttl
properties.description: How long a confirm or cancel button stays valid.

properties.name: agent.approval-intent-ttl
properties.description: How long an approver's approve or reject button stays valid.

properties.name: agent.escalation-phones
properties.description: Staff numbers that get customer escalations, comma separated, for example 254712345678,254722000000. Set with AGENT_ESCALATION_PHONES.

properties.name: agent.max-image-bytes
properties.description: Largest image the agent will read, in bytes.

properties.name: agent.max-document-bytes
properties.description: Largest document the agent will read, in bytes.

properties.name: agent.max-audio-bytes
properties.description: Largest voice note the agent will transcribe, in bytes.

properties.name: agent.max-upload-bytes
properties.description: Largest file a customer can attach in the chat, in bytes.

properties.name: agent.max-text-chars
properties.description: Longest text message accepted, in characters.

properties.name: agent.business-payments
properties.description: Off: the agent only prepares requests for the customer's own M-Pesa (ganji-api). On: it also offers the business tools that need payment-service (Daraja): paying the business by STK Push, refunds, payouts and staff roles. Set with AGENT_BUSINESS_PAYMENTS.
